title: Computing the period of limitation — what is excluded

cards.title: s. 12(1) — first day
cards.text: The day from which the period runs is excluded

cards.title: s. 12(2)–(5) — copies
cards.text: Day of judgment + time from copy application to the day intimated (appeals, reviews, leave, awards)

cards.title: s. 4 — court closed
cards.text: File on the day the court reopens

cards.title: s. 13 — defendant abroad
cards.text: Time of the defendant's absence from Pakistan (suits)

cards.title: s. 14 — wrong court
cards.text: Bona fide proceeding, same parties and cause, defect of jurisdiction

cards.title: s. 15 — stay and notice
cards.text: Time under injunction or stay; period of statutory notice (s. 80 CPC)

cards.title: s. 16 — sale set-aside proceedings
cards.text: For the auction-purchaser's suit for possession

cards.title: ss. 17–18 — death, fraud
cards.text: From a legal representative's existence; from knowledge of fraud

cards.title: ss. 19–20 — fresh start
cards.text: Written acknowledgment or part-payment before expiry

title: Is there a valid acknowledgment under section 19?

q.no: No acknowledgment — an oral admission does not count

q.ask: Is it signed by the party liable or his authorised agent?
Does it admit a subsisting liability or jural relationship?
q.yes: Go on — refusal to pay, set-off or no exact amount does not matter (Expl. I)

q.ask: Was it signed before the period expired?
q.yes: Fresh period from the date of signing (undated? prove the date orally — s. 19(2))
q.no: No revival — consider a signed promise under Contract Act s. 25(3)
